title: Rocky Model Configuration
description: Schema for .rocky.toml sidecar configuration files and _defaults.toml directory defaults

name.description: Model name (defaults to file name stem if omitted)

drop_existing_kind.description: Standing permission to drop this existing target kind when switching between full_refresh and view. Rocky refuses full_refresh or view models carrying this key on every non-DuckDB adapter.

depends_on.description: Explicit model dependencies (auto-detected from SQL if omitted)

table.description: Target table name (defaults to model name)

intent.description: Natural language description of what this model does. Used by 'rocky ai-sync' to propose updates when upstream schemas change

freshness.description: Per-model freshness expectation. `rocky freshness` reports warn past `warn_after` and error past `error_after`.

warn_after.description: Age above which the model reports warn, e.g. "1h" or "7d" (an integer and one unit of s, h or d)

error_after.description: Age above which the model reports error, e.g. "1d". Must not be shorter than warn_after

time_column.description: Timestamp column `rocky freshness` reads MAX() from; without it the last successful build is used

max_lag_seconds.description: Deprecated (W058): write warn_after / error_after. Maximum lag in seconds

severity.description: Deprecated (W058), only with max_lag_seconds: the level that value sits on

strategy_config.description: Materialization strategy — tagged union on the 'type' field

oneOf.description: Full refresh — drop and recreate the target table each run
Merge (upsert) — match on unique key, update or insert

update_columns.description: Columns to update on merge (all non-key columns if omitted)

time_column.description: Column on the model output that holds the partition value

lookback.description: Recompute the previous N partitions on each run (handles late-arriving data)

batch_size.description: Combine N consecutive partitions into one SQL statement when backfilling

first_partition.description: Lower bound for --missing discovery, in canonical key format (e.g., '2024-01-01' for daily)
